title: Danger: Fail/warn when PR targets wrong base branch
body:
## Checklist for Contributors
### Testing
#### Manual testing

We can create PRs to test after merging. If we want to test before merging, we need to allow the script to run on the PR branch first, and then target PRs to it. Maybe we can get away with renaming the PR branch to "release-something". LMK how you wanna proceed, @yannbf 

------
## Agent stuff


- [x] Add `checkTargetBranch` function to `scripts/dangerfile.js` that fails when a non-team-member PR targets `main` or a branch containing `release`, and warns when targeting anything other than `next`
- [x] Add `warn` to the danger import in `scripts/dangerfile.js`
- [x] Update `.github/workflows/danger-js.yml` to also trigger on `release-*` and `*-release` branches
- [x] Remove bot check from `checkTargetBranch` so bots (e.g. storybook-bot) with OWNER/MEMBER association are exempt from the branch check

comments.body:
_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_

**Workflow trigger scope blocks part of the new policy.**

Line 10-14 restricts Danger runs to `main`, `next`, and release-pattern branches. That means PRs targeting any *other* base branch won’t run Danger, so the “warn on any non-`next` target” rule won’t execute.



<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
 on:
   pull_request:
     types:
       - opened
       - synchronize
       - reopened
       - labeled
       - unlabeled
       - edited
-    branches:
-      - main
-      - next
-      - release-*
-      - "*-release"
+    branches:
+      - "**"
```
</details>
